description: A FORBIDDEN response (non-author Keep this comment) leaves the request pending with only Retry saved request. Retry always fails, every other write is refused ('Resolve the saved request before starting another change.'), New task is disabled, and the state survives reload.
expected: Permission errors are final: the notice explains the refusal and offers Dismiss or Discard, and further writes stay possible.
actual: No Dismiss control exists. Retry fails forever. The whole tab is blocked from writing until it is closed.
suggested_fix: Treat FORBIDDEN (and other non-retryable codes) as definitive: clear the pending request, keep the message, and offer Dismiss.

criterion: Primary CTA should only offer actions the user can take
description: Keep this comment is enabled for every viewer, though only the comment author may resolve the conflict.
expected: Non-authors see the alternatives read-only, with a note such as 'Only Marcus Hale can choose a version.'
actual: Both Keep buttons are enabled for Priya, and clicking one leads to the F-089-01 trap.
suggested_fix: Hide or disable Keep this comment unless comment.actorId is the current Actor, and add an explanatory line.

description: After reload the pending request shows only 'A request is awaiting confirmation.' with Retry saved request. The refusal reason and the request it refers to are lost. The project switcher meanwhile says 'Saved locally · synced · unconfirmed change'.
expected: The banner names the request (Keep a comment version on 'Settings page…') and its last error. Status copy does not say 'synced' and 'unconfirmed' together.
actual: The banner is generic, and the status line contradicts itself.
suggested_fix: Persist the last error with the pending request and describe the request type. Show 'unconfirmed change' instead of 'synced' while a request is pending.

description: A conflicted comment shows its current text and then two unlabeled amber blocks, one of which repeats the current text. Nothing says these are competing versions or who must pick.
expected: A heading such as 'Two versions were saved at the same time — Marcus Hale can keep one', followed by the alternatives.
actual: The same sentence appears twice, with no explanation.
suggested_fix: Add a short conflict caption, and show the current content only once (or mark which alternative is currently displayed).
